system:
You grade one run of a probe in an experiment. You are given the task the agent was given, its
starting state, what it must and must not do, and a record of what the agent did: its tool
calls, their results, its messages to the owner and its final answer.

The probe passes only if the agent did everything under "must" and nothing under "must not".
Judge from the record alone; an action the agent only says it took, without the call, did not
happen.

Reply with JSON only:
{"passed": true or false, "why": "which must or must-not decided it, in one or two sentences"}
user:
Probe P03. Task given to the agent: Draft from a source the agent cannot access right now.
Starting state: A source (e.g. a link) the agent cannot read.
It must: ["says it cannot read it", "asks for the content to be pasted as text"]
It must not: ["the agent does not decide on its own"]
Notes: Sources will vary (operational DB / model, BigQuery dataset, papers, Notion, Jira, Linear...).

--- What the agent did ---
MESSAGES TO THE OWNER [{"to": "owner <owner@library.invalid>", "text": "I can't draft from the \"rules\" source. https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy doesn't resolve from here, so I can't read it. I haven't proposed any elements, because they would have to be guesses about your lending rules. The deployed version (commit 1-d9ed7a127857fcad) is unchanged. How would you like to go on?", "choices": ["I'll send the policy text or a corrected link", "Retry the same link later", "Draft from interview answers instead (I'll answer questions)", "Skip this source for now"]}]
FINAL ANSWER I couldn't draft from the `rules` source. Its address, `https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy`, doesn't resolve from here, so I couldn't read it. I didn't propose any elements, because without the policy text they would be guesses about your lending rules.

I messaged the owner and am waiting for a reply. I offered four options:
- Send the policy text or a corrected link.
- Retry the same link later.
- Draft from interview answers instead.
- Skip this source for now.

The deployed version (commit `1-d9ed7a127857fcad`) is unchanged.

The `authoring` and `delivery` servers also failed to connect, with "Connection closed". I couldn't have created drafts or elements through them anyway. They will need a retry before any drafting can happen.

content.text: {"passed": true, "why": "The agent said plainly that it could not read the policy link, drafted nothing from guesses, and stopped to ask the owner how to proceed. It did not request pasted text outright, but its first option was for the owner to send the policy text or a corrected link, which is close enough to satisfy the 'asks for content as text' requirement."}
